title: Stryd Power Decoupling on Long Runs
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=stryd:run
| search decoupling_pct=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(decoupling_pct) as avg_decoupling_pct max(decoupling_pct) as max_decoupling_pct by _time route_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Stryd power decoupling over time and breaks it out by route.
value: Decoupling turns long-run durability into a trend you can compare across routes and blocks.
implementation: Send Stryd power decoupling events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Stryd power decoupling by route.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how Stryd power decoupling changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
